name: FB Marketplace and TikTok Shop Hot Products Radar
description: Collect TikTok Shop bestseller data and FB Marketplace seller/export signals, normalize product metrics, rank hottest products, and report sales or estimated demand.

nodes.name: Daily Product Radar
nodes.notes: Run every morning after TikTok Shop T-1 analytics data is available. Use on-demand runs while testing.

nodes.name: TikTok Shop Bestsellers
nodes.notes: Use TikTok Shop Partner Center API with TikTok Shop Bestsellers or Analytics scope. Sales can be reported as product_sold_count; GMV may be a privacy-protected range depending on endpoint.

integrationSettings.requiredScopes: TikTok Shop Bestsellers, TikTok Shop Analytics

nodes.name: TikTok Research Product Sales
nodes.notes: Optional backup source for eligible research access. Query shop products and request product_sold_count, product_review_count, product_price, product_name, and rating fields.

nodes.name: FB Marketplace Seller Signals
nodes.notes: Import your own seller exports, Meta commerce exports, ads/product breakdowns, or approved third-party Marketplace data. Broad public Marketplace sales are not available through an official Meta Marketplace API.

nodes.name: Normalize and Rank Hot Products
nodes.notes: Merge TikTok and FB product rows, normalize field names, compute hot_score, and separate reported sales from estimated demand.

nodes.name: Keep Strong Candidates
nodes.action: filter records where rule is true
nodes.notes: Keep products with strong hot_score and at least medium confidence; allow low-confidence FB rows only when engagement is very strong.

nodes.name: Excel Export
nodes.notes: Export ranked products with platform, title, category, price, sales_count, sales_type, GMV, hot_score, confidence, and product URL.

nodes.name: OpenAI Product Analyst
nodes.notes: Analyze the shortlist for sourcing opportunity, margin assumptions, saturation risk, ad creative angle, and next test budget.

integrationSettings.promptTemplate: You are an ecommerce product research analyst. Review FB Marketplace and TikTok Shop hot product rows. Prioritize products by reported sales, estimated demand, hot_score, confidence, price, review count, sourcing feasibility, and competition risk. Return a ranked shortlist with why it is trending, evidence quality, estimated demand caveats, suggested supplier keywords, target margin, and next validation step.
integrationSettings.returnFormat: Markdown summary plus JSON array: platform, product_id, title, price, sales_count, sales_type, hot_score, confidence, opportunity_score, sourcing_keywords, risks, next_action.
integrationSettings.dataPolicy: Do not claim estimated FB demand is exact sales. Preserve sales_type and confidence in the recommendation.

nodes.name: Email Daily Radar
nodes.notes: Send the ranked product report to the operator for manual review before sourcing or ad testing.

integrationSettings.subject: FB Marketplace + TikTok Shop Hot Products Radar
integrationSettings.bodyTemplate: Attached is today's hot products report. FB Marketplace sales may be estimated unless marked reported.
